name: Portals - continuous
description: Loops portal runs continuously with no auto-exit. Workflow: open your preferred portal manually (Items -> Portals tab -> click portal), press Play, and the macro takes over from the Activate screen. Every post-run chooser fires a Select-portal click so the next run starts automatically. Runs until fuel runs out (the game will refuse to start the next portal) or you press the macro's stop button. Prefer 'Portals - single portal (exit to lobby)' for one-portal-at-a-time farming, or 'Portals - N portals then exit' for a scheduled stop after N runs. Coords come from Settings > Debug > Macro Coordinates.
